collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Watching a hermit crab change shells, a child wonders whether distant people might carry their homes with them as they travel.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Watching a hermit crab change shells, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant people might carry their homes with them as they travel.

choices.label: Imagine People Who Travel Without Homes.
Ask Whether Isolans Would Want It.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children imagine huts on wheels and roll around the beach pretending.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder wonders how such a home would survive a storm.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that some people might live by moving, setting up camp wherever they stop.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says that wanting to stay in one place is not the only way to belong somewhere.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Most villagers prefer their huts right where they are.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A restless teenager admits it sounds wonderful.
